Mr. Rana, learned senior counsel appearing for the Union of India submitted that the Joint Secretary (Policy & Plan) of the National Disaster Management Authority has sent a communication dated 25.02.2016 to the Chief Secretaries of all the States requiring them to frame minimum standards of relief for victims of disaster.

Be it stated, in paragraphs 2 and 3 of the said letter, it has been mentioned as follows :
2.

As per section 19 of Disaster Management Act, 1005, the State Govts. Are required to lay down detailed guidelines for providing standards of relief to persons affected by disaster in the State, provided that such standards shall, in no case, be less than the Minimum Standards in the Guidelines laid down by the National Authority in this regard.

3. NDMA held various meetings with the representatives of Central ministries/Departments which included Ministry of Health and Family Welfare,
Food Safety and Standard Authority of India, Ministry of Drinking Water and Sanitation and with representatives with the various State Govt. and experts in the field.

sentences.text: After detailed deliberations, NDMA has formulated Guidelines on Minimum Standards of Relief for Food, Water, Sanitation, Medical Cover and Shelter to be provided to persons affected by a disaster and also on Special provisions to be made for Widows and Orphans.

The above document/Guidelibnes is placed on NDMA's website at the following link:
www.ndma.gov.in and a soft copyof the same is attached herewith for taking further necessary action at your end.

Regard being had to the said submission, we require the Chief Secretaries of each of the States in India to comply with the said letter within three weeks and submit their responses to the Union of India.
The said responses shall also be filed before this Court through their respective standing counsel.

In addition to the same, the affidavit filed by the competent authority of the State which will contain the response shall also state, in specific terms, what steps they have taken under the Disaster Management Act, 2005 especially under Sections 23 and 31 of the said Act.

The affidavit filed by respondent No.2, the National Disaster Management Authority,
shall be adverted to on the next date of hearing.
Let the matter be listed on 05.04.2016.
Registry is directed to send a copy of the order passed today to Chief Secretaries of all the States.
(Gulshan Kumar Arora) (H.S. Parasher)
